subtitle: Your phone is the remote now
promotionalText: Tap a tile and your show opens on the big screen. A gorgeous swipe-pad remote for VIZIO SmartCast TVs, with no ads and no tracking.
description:
Clicker turns your iPhone into a fast, beautiful remote for VIZIO SmartCast TVs.

TAP A TILE, IT OPENS ON THE TV
Your streaming apps live on big glowing tiles. Tap one and it launches on your TV in a second, no hunting through menus. Add or remove apps from a list of more than 100.

A REMOTE THAT FEELS GOOD
Swipe anywhere on the pad to move, tap to select. Back, Home and Menu are one tap away, with play/pause, skip, volume you can hold to repeat, mute, input and power.

KNOWS WHAT'S ON
Clicker shows which app is on the TV right now, updated live.

SET UP IN SECONDS
Clicker finds your TV on your Wi-Fi automatically. Type the 4-digit code your TV shows and you're in.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking, no servers. Clicker talks only to your TV, directly over your home network.

Works with VIZIO SmartCast TVs (2016 and newer) on the same Wi-Fi network as your iPhone.
